Standalone /athanor:lfg runs the pipeline through athanor-native commands. v0.11.4 closes the deployment-path arc with v0.11.3's input-layer fix — Stop hook reachable in every project via `${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}` expansion in `hooks/hooks.json` (companion-fix; v0.11.3 corrected the stdin parser, v0.11.4 corrects the hook command path). Stop hook with multi-script confusables fold + paraphrase regex + conditional/attribution suppression.
